Rules every man should follow
with his first car

1. Learn to change a tire

Before you need to.

2. Never let it drop
below a quarter tank

3. Keep it clean inside

Your car shows how you live.

4. Phone out of reach
while driving

5. Learn how it works

Oil, brakes, battery.
The basics save money.
